title: Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk
description: Add Election Defeat Creatures Back to Minecraft.
body:
Add Election Defeat Creatures Back to Minecraft.

# \--- Creatures ---

## Moobloom

A Moobloom is a passive mob found in most flower biomes.

Totally ADD 25 Types for Moobloom.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KqwFl74W/images/12a939f14a2fe6e7e2aca5d5526d3a2ccf3fc060.png)

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KqwFl74W/images/4ca4bbae2ef9ff6a1fb284191e04883af2e52a29.png)

### Breeding!

Mooblooms follow players holding wheat

Only the Same Type can breed.

### Shearable!

Plucked 1~3 flower.

A sheared Moobloom regrowing its flowers after eating grass.

### Milking(TODO)

use bowl to milk Suspicious Stew

The Potion Effect of Stew is decide by Moobloom's Type.

need futuremc to add Suspicious Stew in 1.12.2

### WITHER ROSE!

CANT Breed

Inflict the **Wither effect** to any players or non-immune mobs touching it.
